episode: Task: start the director package inside the public evolving-agents repository. Its memory is the lab's own way of working and names private projects. The user's decision, 2026-10-14: the code is public; the memory, the sandboxes built from it, the plans, the judge's verdicts and the transcripts live in the private directory ~/.config/director/ (the private config too) and never in any repository; case files use placeholders such as {PRIVATE_PROJECT}, filled from the private config at run time; only scores, counts and costs are published.

Task: add golden cases for the bisect command to agentvcs. The cases under conformance/cases/ are generated by conformance/tools/gen.py: verdicts are declared by hand there and hashes are filled in by conformance/tools/ref.py. CI regenerates the cases and fails unless the result is byte-identical to what is committed, and it runs the whole suite against three CLIs: the release binary, `python -m agentvcs` (the wheel) and the reference conformance/tools/refcli.py. Adding cases for a command therefore meant declaring them in gen.py, implementing the command in ref.py and refcli.py, regenerating, and running all three. A case.json is never edited by hand.

Task: edit the evolving-agents README. The local clone of github.com/EvolvingAgentsLabs/evolving-agents is ~/evolvingagents/evolving-agents-readme; there is no ~/evolvingagents/evolving-agents directory, and a `cd` there failed. The clone's checked-out branch was an old feature branch that had already been merged, so the first branch was created from it by mistake; the fix was to switch to main and pull before branching.

Task: show the director's local interface working. A browser screenshot of http://127.0.0.1:8740 captured the frontier lane's transcript, which prints absolute paths under the user's home directory (/Users/<account>/…). It was kept out of the public repository. Correction: any picture or recording meant for a public README or the website is first read back for local paths, account names and private names, and scrubbed (cropped, or re-recorded from a neutral path) before it is committed.

Task: ship bisect in agentvcs (pull request merged, CI green). The organisation's profile README (EvolvingAgentsLabs/.github, profile/README.md) and the website's home page both still listed `bisect --exec` under 'not built', and were fixed only afterwards. Correction: when a project's built / not-built state changes, the same series of pull requests updates the project's README, the organisation profile and the website home before the work is reported as done.
